text.p: A pair of initial public offerings made lukewarm debuts on Wednesday amid a broad market decline, with Cresud SACIF y A gaining slightly and Endocardial Solutions Inc showing no change by early afternoon.
American Depositary Shares of Cresud SACIF y A, an Argentine agricultural property company, were priced at $18.50 each in a deal lead-managed by Merrill Lynch.

Of the 5.4 million ADSs in the issue, 3.4 million were offered to the public in the United States, Europe and Argentina, and two million made up a rights offering for existing shareholders, according to Merrill Lynch. The U.S. tranche consisted of 1.36 million ADSs.
The ADSs, each of which represents 10 common shares, rose 1/8 to 18-5/8 on the Nasdaq.

Shares of Endocardial Solutions were priced at $9 each, below their estimated price range of $10 to $12, and settled there after reaching a high of 9-1/4. The three million share issue had Piper Jaffray as lead underwriter.
St.Paul, Minnesota-based Endocardial is developing a minimally invasive system for diagnosing tachycardia, an abnormal heart rhythm that can be fatal.
